docs.description: useLayoutEffect called directly instead of useSafeLayoutEffect
docs.why: useLayoutEffect warns during SSR; useSafeLayoutEffect swaps it for useEffect on the server
docs.fix: import useSafeLayoutEffect and call it instead

rules.message: useLayoutEffect is called directly — use useSafeLayoutEffect

docs.description: useInsertionEffect called directly instead of useStyleEffect
docs.why: useInsertionEffect warns during SSR; useStyleEffect swaps it for useEffect on the server
docs.fix: import useStyleEffect and call it instead

rules.message: useInsertionEffect is called directly — use useStyleEffect

docs.description: store selector returns a fresh reference
docs.why: a fresh reference defeats Object.is — infinite re-render under zustand v5
docs.fix: select primitives, or memoize the selector with useShallow
